blind.description: A sculpted bronze bust of a horned demon or devil. It features two large curved horns, pointed ears, furrowed brow ridges, red glowing eyes, an open gaping mouth, and a beard tapering to a point. The head is mounted on a small integral circular flared pedestal base that sits flat on the floor. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with no hovering fragments or defects.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a rounded skull with two horns projecting to the sides and curving upward/back, with the nose and brow ridge pointing toward the bottom of the frame.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet tall (around one-third to one-fourth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 feet wide across the horns.
